 Job Description: 
 JR Automation is seeking a motivated and talented Software Engineering Intern/Co-op to join our dynamic team. 

 Work Location: This is a hybrid/remote position located in Greenville, SC.

 This program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, automation, and engineering practices. You will work closely with our experienced engineers on real-world projects that impact our clients and the industry.

 How You’ll Make an Impact: 
 
• Develop and/or maintain a wide range of software solutions. 
• Demonstrate flexibility, both in terms of the nature of assignments and working hours. 
• Take an active role in learning the skills necessary to accomplish assigned tasks through a combination of self-study and engaging experienced team members for guidance/instruction. 
• Make positive contributions to the company in response to the training provided. 
• Approach all assignments with an appropriate sense of urgency in order to meet required timelines. 
• Travel as necessary to complete assignments. 
 Note:  This list of responsibilities is by no means all-inclusive; however, it is intended to be a guideline for activities.

 What You’ll Bring: 
 
• High School Diploma or equivalent. 
• Enrolled in a bachelor’s degree (or higher) program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similarly applicable field. 
• Basic proficiency in at least one modern programming language. 
• Strong desire and intention to pursue a career in software engineering. 
 Disclaimer: JR Automation requires candidates to successfully complete a 10-panel drug screen, physical examination, and background check.

 Company Overview:  

 At JR Automation, A Hitachi Group Company, we discover potential, reimagine limits, and advance industry. When faced with a problem, we find a solution. Together, we push what’s possible to automate for tomorrow.

 Join our team of 2,000+ at one of our 20+ facilities around the world and be a part of the most experienced team of advanced automation integrators. 

 Fueled by Possible. 

 Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE)-Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job at JR Automation, please send the nature of request and contact information to jrcareers@jrautomation.com. Queries other than accommodation requests will not be responded to.
